title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Service Standards
content:
For **Area and Security Lighting Rental**, the cooperative works to the following service standards. They are the same for all seven fixtures: the LED 40W Security Light, LED 70W Area Light, LED 110W Flood Light, LED 150W Flood Light, HPS 100W Security Light, HPS 250W Flood Light and Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light.

## Standards card

| Standard | Every fixture |
|---|---|
| Installation, counted from a request whose easement is complete | 15 business days |
| Repair, counted from a confirmed report | 5 business days |
| Repairs made outside business hours | No, light repairs are made during business hours |
| Business days a confirmed light-out may remain unrepaired before rental credit applies | 10 business days |
| How an outage rental credit is figured | Prorated by calendar days: the rental is credited for each calendar day out, divided by the days of the billing period |
| Photocells and lamps replaced at no charge | Yes |
| Removal, counted from a confirmed removal request | 10 business days |
| Channels for reporting a light out | A live member services representative by phone, the automated phone line, the SmartHub app, and the cooperative's website |

## Points of reading

- All the time standards on this card are counted in **business days**; only the outage credit itself is figured in **calendar days**.
- The installation clock is counted from a request whose easement is complete, the repair clock from a confirmed report, and the removal clock from a confirmed removal request.
- Ten business days is the limit a confirmed light-out may stay unrepaired before rental credit applies; the repair standard of five business days is a separate figure.
- The four reporting channels are interchangeable: a light-out reported through any one of them is a report.
